items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tony? Tony? Tony Majora. [INTERVIEWEE] And the piano player, I can't see at all. The piano player is Dominic Baraka.

ctx.x: A natural death. A little Hardy. Who? A little Hardy. Not even Hardy, man. He's Hardy. Who's the trumpet player, Doubles on the Tunnel? Tony? Tony?

And the piano player, I can't see at all. The piano player is Dominic Baraka. Oh, Dominic Baraka. What happened to Andy Hardy? He played the hornbow. Did you play with him? No, I wouldn't play with him. What did he play like? He played kind of like Lewis.
